# China to enhance AI education in primary, secondary schools

gov.cn (State Council portal), Xinhua, December 3, 2024 (updated 07:57). Full article retrieved.

## Key findings
- The **Ministry of Education (MOE)** called for efforts to explore approaches to AI education in primary and secondary schools, emphasizing cultivating creativity, scientific interest, and digital skills.
- Schools are asked to **establish related curriculums, incorporate AI into routine teaching content, and conduct regular evaluations** (per a ministry circular).
- **Progression by age**:
  - Early primary school: hands-on experience with AI technologies.
  - Senior primary + junior high: focus on understanding and applying AI technologies.
  - Senior high: AI project creation and exploration of cutting-edge AI applications.
- An **AI section will be added to a national smart education platform** to pool quality resources and enhance accessibility.
- Authorities will **encourage colleges, universities, research institutes, and high-tech companies to open their AI labs and exhibition halls** to primary and secondary school students.
- **Minister of Education Huai Jinpeng** likened AI to a "gold key" for the education system — potential to shape the future of education while presenting both opportunities and challenges.
- In **February 2024**, the country selected **184 schools as pilot bases** to explore philosophies, models, and programs in AI education, with the goal of developing exemplary cases and experience promotable at larger scale. More such bases will be established.

## Assessment
- `authoritative: yes` — gov.cn (State Council portal) republishing the MOE circular via Xinhua; primary/official source.
